dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Excuse me, does this bus go to the museum?

glosses.meaning: a big vehicle that carries many people

dialogue.en: Please, will this bus take me to the museum?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. Buy a ticket here. It is two dollars.

glosses.meaning: a paper or card that lets you travel

dialogue.en: Yes. Get your paper to travel here. It costs $2.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Here you are. When does it arrive?
dialogue.en: This is the money. At what time does it reach the place?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It arrives in twenty minutes. Get off at the next stop after the bank.

glosses.meaning: a place where a bus stops

dialogue.en: It reaches it in 20 minutes. Leave at the stop after the bank.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Thank you. How often does the bus come?

glosses.meaning: a big vehicle that carries many people

dialogue.en: Thanks. How many times does the bus come?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A bus comes every ten minutes.

glosses.meaning: a big vehicle that carries many people
